name: Pixel Vibe
description: A halftone dot screen fades over the frame while it flares in exposure, punches in with a zoom blur and shakes, cutting to the second clip at the midpoint. Recreation of the CapCut "Pixel Vibe" transition. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: duration
params.description: Real transition length in seconds; sets the speed of the shake
